description: Compare the best real rates across MULTIPLE lending products in a single call — e.g. show a buyer mortgage vs HELOC, or new vs used auto. Runs the decision engine for each product and returns a ranked, true-cost (APR + fees) table. Use this instead of calling get_financing_decision repeatedly. Each product returns its top offer with rate, APR, and monthly payment.

product_types.description: Products to compare, e.g. ["mortgage","heloc"]. Any of: mortgage, mortgage_arm, auto, rv, boat, motorcycle, powersports, heloc, personal_loan, credit_card, student_loan. "mortgage" is fixed-rate and "mortgage_arm" is adjustable — comparing them side by side is meaningful, but they are never blended into one ranking. Boats/RVs/motorcycles/powersports are first-class product types; auto means cars.

name: compare_products

amount.description: Loan amount in dollars every product was priced at, so the rows are comparable.

best_overall.description: Product type with the lowest true cost across the compared rows, e.g. 'heloc'.

intent.description: Borrowing purpose the pricing assumes, e.g. 'purchase' or 'refinance'.

note.description: Plain-English interpretation of the numbers above, already phrased for the user; quote it rather than re-deriving the comparison.

products.description: One row per requested product type, each showing that product's single best lender.

apr.description: Best APR for this product as a percent string, including fees where published; this is what the rows were ranked on.

available.description: True when live offers were found for this product; false means the row has no pricing rather than that the product is unattractive.

best_lender.description: Credit union offering the best deal for this product type.

display_name.description: Normalized name of the specific product that won this row, e.g. '15-Year Fixed'. Note that the winning term may differ between rows.

monthly_payment.description: Estimated monthly payment as a formatted dollar string. Payments across rows are not like-for-like when the terms differ.

product_type.description: Product category for this row, e.g. 'mortgage', 'heloc'.

rate.description: Best note rate for this product as a percent string, excluding fees.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.
